screens.title: Initial loading
screens.summary: Illustrative pending state. No records, counts, or saved outcomes are known yet.

panels.title: Loading tasks...
lines: A labeled progress indicator identifies the pending view.
Do not present a pending request as an empty result.

panels.title: Available context
lines: Keep page identity and repository scope understandable.
Dependent actions wait for their required data.

checks: Can users tell which view is loading?
Is loading distinguishable from zero results?
Are actions dependent on unavailable data withheld?

transitions.label: Read succeeds
transitions.condition: The current scope returns readable task data.

screens.title: No matching results
screens.summary: Illustrative filtered empty state after a successful read. It does not imply the workspace has no records.

panels.title: No matching tasks
lines: Try a different title, source number, or status.
Clear filters restores the broader task view.

panels.title: First-use empty state
lines: No records yet uses different guidance from no matches.
Unavailable cleanup data is not treated as zero Active tasks.

checks: Does the message distinguish no matches from no records yet?
Is there a direct way to clear the active filters?
Are unavailable resource data and empty Active results kept distinct?

transitions.label: Clear search and status filters
transitions.condition: A successful read contains records outside the prior filters.

screens.title: Refresh failed
screens.summary: Illustrative refresh failure with retained readable data. This differs from an initial failure with no saved snapshot.

panels.title: Retain readable context
lines: Show the last successful snapshot with a visible warning.
Retry refresh without implying the data is current.

panels.title: Constrain stale actions
lines: Task cancellation and recovery require a successful refresh.
If access is denied, protected cached content is hidden.

checks: Is retained data clearly labeled as the last successful snapshot?
Does a failed refresh preserve useful reading context?
Are stale mutations and access-denied caches handled differently?

transitions.label: Retry refresh succeeds
transitions.condition: The refreshed snapshot passes identity and access checks.

transitions.label: Access was revoked
transitions.condition: The read is denied rather than temporarily unavailable.

screens.title: Permission required
screens.summary: Illustrative restricted view. This diagram neither changes access nor establishes the current user's permissions.

panels.title: Administrator access required
lines: Account management explains its permission requirement.
My account remains the place to inspect personal access.

panels.title: Protected record access
lines: A denied source or task read hides protected cached data.
Explain which access is missing before offering a retry.

checks: Does the message identify the specific permission boundary?
Is protected cached content hidden after access is denied?
Does returning to another view avoid implying access was granted?

transitions.label: Open permitted account management
transitions.condition: The session has the required administrator access.

transitions.label: Return to accessible records
transitions.condition: The session can read the selected repository.

screens.title: Initial load failed
screens.summary: Illustrative first-load failure with no readable snapshot. Do not substitute an empty list or a saved result.

panels.title: The report could not be loaded
lines: Show the request error and a scoped Retry action.
Do not invent counts, conclusions, or report contents.

panels.title: Different from refresh failure
lines: No retained content is available to keep reading.
A successful retry is required before dependent actions.

checks: Is a request failure distinct from a successful empty result?
Does Retry apply to the failed request?
Are unavailable records kept out of action previews?

transitions.label: Retry report read succeeds
transitions.condition: Readable report data is returned for the current identity.

transitions.label: Read is denied
transitions.condition: The response identifies an access restriction.
